pages.text: A few systems react to what you build. None of them are punishing on their own, but a big base notices all of them.

$(li)$(bold)Burning pollutes.$() Furnaces, burners and stoves add smog to their chunk. Smog keeps its default rates, so it stays punishing. Flues and air scrubbers fix it.$(li)$(bold)Heat warms you.$() Factories near you count toward body temperature.

$(li)$(bold)Height is cold.$() Cold Sweat: Altitude makes the sky chilly, which matters for airships. Cold Sweat is tuned gentler than default.$(li)$(bold)Water isn't clean.$() Drink purified water, or build a filter.$(li)$(bold)Seasons turn.$() Plan farms around them.

$(bold)Cold Sweat and Thirst work together.$() Thirst Was Reclaimed uses Cold Sweat's temperature readings, so the heat or cold around you feeds into its thirst system. Dress for the weather and carry water.
